issue.title: One tie per task pair — dependencies absorb plain links
issue.description: A task pair can hold a dependency or a plain (unlabelled) link, never both, in either direction. Every Bob writer enforces it. Reconcile heals hand edits in the dependency's favour. The four Obsidian relationship stages show each pair's tie at a glance and convert it with Ctrl plus the Task Card key, and capture plus Bob Mac Capture explain the rule.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202611/plain_link_dependency_ties.md requests this work

issue.title: Contract, shared vectors, and the Rust tie helpers

issue.title: Reconcile fold and merge pruning
issue.description: reconcile-fold: bob task reconcile drops plain LINKS entries on dependency-joined pairs and reports absorbed_plain_links. bob task merge prunes the overlaps its repointing would create. Dry-run the fold against the live vault without applying it.

issue.title: Capture absorption, the plain-~ no-op, and the same-item error
issue.description: capture-writers: & and * absorb the pair's plain links in the same staged write. A plain ~ / ~~ over a dependency becomes a reported no-op, and & plus a plain ~ to one target in a single item is a teaching error. Both report additive JSON and human output.
